inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL batch update maps several primary-key values through CASE expressions, assigns more than one column in one UPDATE, and preserves non-target rows with an ELSE branch.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a catalog curation update. A single UPDATE assigns shelf positions and publication labels for selected catalog entries by item ID, preserves each selected value through explicit ELSE branches, excludes an untouched archived entry, and verifies the ordered final catalog; the source schema, identifiers, values, and tutorial data are not copied.

fixture_notes: Catalog items 401, 402, and 403 receive different shelf positions and publication labels in one update. Item 404 is outside the target set and remains archived; explicit ELSE branches preserve the selected rows' values when a CASE branch is not matched.
determinism_notes: The target IDs are unique primary keys, every CASE expression has an explicit ELSE branch, the WHERE predicate names all intended rows, and the final read orders by item ID; there are no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE catalog_items (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, item_title VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, shelf_position INT NOT NULL, publication_label VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, item_state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO catalog_items VALUES (401, 'North Wind', 9, 'draft', 'active'), (402, 'Quiet River', 8, 'draft', 'active'), (403, 'Amber Field', 7, 'draft', 'active'), (404, 'Old Harbor', 1, 'legacy', 'archived')

steps.sql: UPDATE catalog_items SET shelf_position = CASE item_id WHEN 401 THEN 3 WHEN 402 THEN 1 WHEN 403 THEN 2 ELSE shelf_position END, publication_label = CASE item_id WHEN 401 THEN 'featured' WHEN 402 THEN 'standard' WHEN 403 THEN 'featured' ELSE publication_label END WHERE item_id IN (401, 402, 403)
SELECT item_id, item_title, shelf_position, publication_label, item_state FROM catalog_items ORDER BY item_id
